ctx.x: 1926. So that morning we all were there. Everybody got to the station but Roy, the trumpet player. And the train came and we got on the train and he got left. So we went on in to Kansas City and I don't have any instrument. But anyway, that day was Labor Day and everything was happening there. They had dances there, George Lee was playing one place, Bennie Moten was playing someplace else. So I made all the dances because I wanted to hear the bands. This is the first time I'd met Lamar Wright who later came with…

So I was there without an instrument so I'd had to try to find my way to make some kind of -- I didn't want to let my mother know I was there because I knew she would send for me. So I bummed around Kansas City for two or three days, living
